capabilities.name: Sandbox policy validator
capabilities.description: Validates strict policy structure, bounded CPU/memory/time/process/output limits, read-only root intent, explicit POSIX paths, default-deny network intent and execution-disabled state.
limitations: Validates declarations only; does not enforce OS resource, filesystem or network controls.

capabilities.name: Fail-closed admission prerequisite evaluator
capabilities.description: Rejects missing or non-boolean identity, policy, artifact, revocation, emergency-stop and backend evidence; reference implementation always denies actual execution.
limitations: No authentication, policy decision service, revocation service, emergency-control runtime or isolation backend integration.

explicit_non_capabilities: Container, VM, namespace, seccomp, AppArmor or SELinux enforcement
Workload execution or arbitrary code execution
